name: The Basement: The Horror Game
source:
Four friends plan to stay the night in an old house of a killer after hes been sent to jail, but after being locked in they soon realize that they might not be alone.
[From [url=https://blakemackplays.itch.io/the-basment] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
四位朋友计划在杀人犯入狱后，到他住过的老房子里过夜。但被锁在里面后，他们很快意识到，那里可能并不只有他们。

（来源：[url=https://blakemackplays.itch.io/the-basment]itch.io[/url]）
